name: Palmed Card
flavor: There was nothing in that hand a moment ago. There is no reason for the thing in your shoulder either, and yet.
description: Your empty hand produces something with an edge and sends it on its way in the same motion. Make a {{trick attack|d20 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier}} against a creature you can see within range; on a hit it takes [[1d8]] psychic damage from a wound it cannot account for and will not find afterwards. Because this is an attack roll rather than a saving throw, it can be parried like any other attack — and because it is a Pledge, your Palmed feature lets you throw it inside a Turn you were casting anyway.
narration: The hand was open. You are certain the hand was open. Then there is a flick of the wrist, a sound like a card being dealt, and something is very wrong under your collarbone.
sheetSummary: Action, 30 ft. Ranged trick attack ({{d20 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier|your trick attack bonus}}). Hit: [[1d8]] psychic. Scales at 5/11/17. Can be parried.
